data.hypothesis: Parallelizing independent output rows with a contiguous static partition should expose CPU parallelism while avoiding the round-robin assignment of single-row chunks; team startup may outweigh the benefit for small workloads.
data.notes: Unmeasured candidate for the stated four-core ARM64 target. Rows are independent, and each output element retains its original accumulation order, preserving correctness across sizes, seeds, and repeats.
transformations: Enabled OpenMP parallel work sharing over the independent outer row loop.
Changed to schedule(static) without an explicit chunk to distribute contiguous row ranges and minimize scheduling overhead; removed the now-unused chunk parameter.
